observations: The production change filters the fixed438 exception-count input to exactly the two eligible translation codes. Exact count295+143, exception IDs, expected Easy clue membership and accepted review bindings remain enforced.

The helper publishes only the translation exception field. publishValidationReport performs a top-level merge preserving validation and unrelated report fields; fresh validation still treats INVALID_SOURCE_LICENSE as nonwaivable.

readPreRepairContent verifies the current accepted afterSHA, restores every exact unique afterRaw to beforeRaw record, and verifies the resulting beforeSHA. Missing, duplicate, changed or inconsistent deltas fail; it returns bytes without changing content files.

The test reconstructs the actual frozen8374-row historical phase in temporary files from verified pre-repair bytes and original baseline IDs. Historical catalog/threshold mocks are local to this historical test; current-bank validation is unchanged.

The regression applies all approved438 translation IDs and attempted generic/per-clue licence waiver IDs, then proves exactly five INVALID_SOURCE_LICENSE errors remain blocking and are absent from the exception list.

The added persistence assertion seeds the temporary report with that actual five-error blocking validation, reruns the real helper, and compares the whole preserved validation object plus the five blocking errors.
Existing manifest-binding, artifact-byte tamper, rerun stability and concurrent-report guards remain tested.
